title: Eurasia Needs More New Pilots Than North America
hook: Eurasia needs 143,000 new pilots—more than North America.
closing: The next aviation bottleneck may be trained people, not available airplanes.
question: Can pilot training expand quickly enough to meet demand?

segments.say: Airlines will need 649,000 new pilots as global travel demand keeps expanding.
Eurasia needs 143,000 new pilots, exceeding every other region in the comparison.
The global aircraft fleet could reach 48,600, intensifying competition for qualified crews.
